active.description: Turn the prompt on or off for future runs.

archived.description: True archives the prompt: it is turned off, never runs again, and keeps its check history. Send it without other fields. False restores an archived prompt. A restored prompt stays off unless 'active' is true in the same request. An archived prompt accepts no other change until it is restored.

current_version.description: Make an existing version current again, for example to roll back a text change. Adds no version. Fails with 400 when the version does not exist, and with 409 when another prompt has its text.

prompt.description: New text for the prompt. A change adds the next version and makes it current; the prompt keeps its id and its check history, and each check records the version that ran. A change of case or whitespace only adds no version. Fails with 409 when another prompt in the set already has the text.

topic.description: New topic for the prompt. An empty string removes the topic. Past checks keep the topic they ran with.

version_description.description: Optional note on what the text change does, stored on the new version. Send it with 'prompt'.
